description: A warm bakery with a genuine cut-out domed masonry oven and open chimney, brick arch, recessed wood store and visible flame; tray rack and ingredient jars; sink and wall windows; kneading bench with dough, rolling pin and flour sack; curved transparent pastry case with three shelves; separate register counter; and a small round café table. BAKERY, FLOUR and Good Bread / Brighter Days preserve the source English wording.
differences: The 7.2 × 6.4m floor, hidden construction and all dimensions are inferred. Brickwork and bread scoring are simplified; croissants and cakes use readable stylized forms instead of the exact pastry assortment. The shelving is less crowded, curtain/lighting embellishments are reduced, and the menu font differs. The source does not define an entrance, so the open presentation side is retained rather than inventing a visible door. Godot uses one deliberate transparent glazing material; the original image has more complex reflections and warm bounce light.
collision: The oven has a real arched cavity and a shallow dark lining positioned for the review angle. Counters, rack and furniture have simple collision boxes; decorative pastry, glass and tools do not introduce gameplay collision.
